rule: Never add page-level tabs unless explicitly requested. Left nav handles section navigation.

indicator.description: Sliding animated underline — built into the default tab list. Always include a inside every .ds-tabs-list and call moveTabsIndicator(listEl) on init.
indicator.css: .ds-tabs-indicator { position:absolute; bottom:0; height:2px; background:var(--shell-accent); border-radius:1px; transition:left 200ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), width 200ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); pointer-events:none; }

do: Use tabs only within a page section or detail panel — never at page level unless explicitly requested.
Max 5 visible tabs — add an overflow menu for more.
Always include inside .ds-tabs-list for the sliding underline.
Active tab: color:#6360D8 with sliding 2px indicator at bottom.
Show only one ds-tab-panel at a time — toggle 'active' class via JS.
Call moveTabsIndicator(listEl) on init and after each tab click.
dont: Never add page-level tabs without an explicit user request.
Never use tabs to replace left nav section switching.
Never exceed 5 visible tabs without an overflow mechanism.
Never use border-radius on tab buttons — indicator is bottom-border only.
Never add a per-tab border-bottom active style — the sliding indicator handles it.

react.note: Use Radix Tabs — handles keyboard navigation and ARIA roles automatically. Compute indicator position via useRef on the active tab element.
